description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Privacy & Product Legal Counsel role ⭐️

We're at a pivotal moment in our journey, scaling across multiple countries while handling some of our members' most sensitive data and building increasingly sophisticated health products that require thoughtful privacy-by-design approaches. As we mature, the complexity and impact of privacy decisions grow exponentially, making this role critical to our continued success.

That is where you come in.

You'll work at the intersection of privacy, AI, health, product, and innovation, contributing to Alan's position on opportunities and risks as early as the strategy and roadmapping stage. With tens of features or completely new services that can involve novel uses of health data being discussed or launched every couple of months, you'll need to find radical shortcuts and paint the bigger picture behind individual ideas.

What you will do

  • 🤝 Co-build products with the teams. Advise on new features and run privacy‑by‑design reviews with Product, Data and Engineering, so that privacy is part of the product from the first sketch.

  • 🧭 Handle complex privacy and product topics end to end, including in highly regulated health fields, across France, Belgium, Spain and Canada.

  • 🛠️ Help run our privacy and product compliance program: documentation, guidelines and processes.

  • 🤖 Build tools that let teams decide on their own: frameworks, templates, automations. Our Legal function is distributed and transparent, and we want everyone to be able to make good calls without waiting for a lawyer.

  • 🌱 Share what you know and help the Legal team grow over time, including through hiring and mentoring.

How we work

Legal at Alan is a small team that works in the open, close to the business:

  • We prefer enabling over gatekeeping: we look for pragmatic solutions, we explain trade‑offs in plain words, and we keep our members' interests at the center of every decision.

  • You will own your projects and your priorities, juggle several topics at once, and be trusted to find our own solutions rather than simply following market practice.

  • We also like to explore how AI and automation can improve legal work, from drafting and research to repetitive tasks.

Who you will work with

  • The rest of the Legal team, Marion Bergeret, François Zannotti, Camille Leflour, Paul Ambrosino, the security team and care experts.

  • Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Health professionals, Operations, Design and Data teams on a daily basis.

What your first year could look like

  • First 6 months: you become the go-to legal partner for your product scope. You advise the team on your own, and take ownership of part of our privacy and product compliance program.

  • First year: you have left your mark on what we ship. You have co-built features with Product teams, owned your own workstreams from start to finish, taken on complex health topics, and widened your scope. You have also delivered frameworks, templates or automations that let teams move faster on their own.

  • Beyond: you become a trusted reference on privacy and product law at Alan, for Product teams and, over time, in conversations with regulators.


⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • Strong GDPR expertise across several jurisdictions (France, Belgium and Spain are particularly interesting) and the ability to work on privacy topics from day one.

  • At least 3 years of experience, including law firm experience in privacy/IT/technology advisory.

  • Fluency in French and English (everyone at Alan works in English).

  • A French and/or foreign bar qualification.

  • A strong commercial and contractual skillset, and experience advising tech companies and working with product teams.

  • Clear written communication, and the ability to turn complex legal questions into simple options and recommendations for non‑lawyers.

  • A hands‑on, pragmatic approach to risk: you enjoy helping teams find a way forward.

  • Curiosity about AI and automation, and a desire to explore how they can improve legal work.

For this role, we hire within the C1–E level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work
